payload.title: Two adapters each hand-implement 'a scan root is a file or a directory' on top of adapter-fs, with different behaviour for an absent or refused root, because collectFiles cannot take a file root
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:364-376 (docsUnder: containedWorkspace().entry decides file versus walk; a non-markdown file throws)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:377-384 (an absent root is dropped by the workspacePathExists filter and skipped silently)
tools/aria-adapters/infrastructure-policy-adapter.ts:362-373 (the same entry() dispatch, but an absent or refused root throws)
tools/aria-adapters/infrastructure-policy-adapter.ts:376-387 (file roots kept as themselves, directories walked with collectFiles)
tools/aria-adapters/adapter-fs.ts:211-233 (collectFiles lists a directory; there is no root-kind aware walk to share)
tools/aria-adapters/adapter-fs.ts:67-75 (adapter-fs documents the one containment rule every adapter path check goes through)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md single-owner discipline: one place decides what a scan root may be; adapter-fs.ts is the documented single authority for containment of workspace paths.
payload.notes: The same manifest root list gives different outcomes in the two adapters: a root that no longer exists is skipped silently by doc-staleness (the scan shrinks with no signal) and refused loudly by infrastructure-policy. A third adapter that needs file roots will copy the dispatch a third time, and a change to the containment rule (refused entry, symlink) must be made in each copy. Close condition: Add one file-aware root walk to adapter-fs.ts, with the absent-root policy stated once, and have both adapters call it; a spec fails when an adapter other than adapter-fs.ts calls containedWorkspace().entry to classify a scan root. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 1). Verified at head a47dc4d57c of open pull request #2134; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
